pages.title: Pudu
pages.text: The pudu ($(o)Pudu puda$()), or southern pudu, is a tiny deer native to the temperate rainforests of southern Chile and western Argentina.$(br2)It is one of the smallest deer in the world, standing under half a metre at the shoulder, and males grow only short, spike-like antlers.$(br2)Pudus are shy and solitary, moving through dense undergrowth to browse on leaves, buds, fruit and fallen seeds.
